description: 1. The agent must locate and execute `./generate.sh` with BOTH required arguments: the topic 'health and wellness' and the target audience 'busy healthcare professionals'. Running the script with just one argument or with the wrong audience will cause the evaluation to fail the audience check. 2. The script outputs `content-calendar.md` in the current directory (root of workspace). The agent must NOT use any pre-existing draft files (content-calendar-draft.md in campaigns/ or old_content_calendar.md in archive/). 3. The generated calendar must contain all 7 days (Monday–Sunday) each with the correct SKILL.md-defined daily theme (e.g., Monday=Motivational, Wednesday=Engagement/Question, etc.). 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP 1 — Twitter char limit: Each Twitter/X post body must be ≤280 characters. The agent must use the script (which handles this) rather than writing posts manually. 5. PROPRIETARY TRAP 2 — Platform-specific hashtag counts: Twitter requires 2–3 hashtags, LinkedIn requires 3–5 hashtags, and Instagram requires 5–10 hashtags. An agent relying on generic knowledge might use the same hashtag count across all platforms. 6. PROPRIETARY TRAP 3 — The correct audience string must be passed as the second positional argument; forgetting it defaults to 'general audience' which fails the audience check. 7. Each platform section must include best posting times as specified in the skill.
